title: Critz: Tycoon — Thirty Different Days
status: Awaiting listening review; not integrated into gameplay

tracks.title: The First Open Window
tracks.story: Morning arrives before the plans do. A small room starts to feel like a beginning.
tracks.personality: Felt-piano miniature; three-note questions, long silences, a rising middle register.

tracks.title: Soup Cooling on the Table
tracks.story: Mom has left a bowl for you. Nothing needs to be won tonight.
tracks.personality: An electric-piano waltz with a singing inner voice and no percussion.

tracks.title: A Button with Feet
tracks.story: A tiny critter steals a button and proudly carries it three steps.
tracks.personality: Dry marimba hops; a low triangle answers in the gaps. Mostly two voices.

tracks.title: Kaid Takes the Other Handle
tracks.story: The box is too heavy alone. Kaid takes the other side without being asked.
tracks.personality: A square-wave and reed duet: neither voice owns the whole tune.

tracks.title: Rootport on a Tuesday
tracks.story: Shop doors open at different times. Everyone still finds the same unhurried rhythm.
tracks.personality: A syncopated organ trio, walking bass, and quiet brushed time.

tracks.title: Mossway beyond the Map
tracks.story: The road bends out of sight. You go far enough to find a view that belongs to you.
tracks.personality: A compound-meter travelling tune with picked bass and an upward pulse arpeggio.

tracks.title: The Page with No Answer
tracks.story: A notebook question leads to another question, and that feels like progress.
tracks.personality: Bright fourths and a raised fourth; bell phrases of three, five and six bars over held plucks.

tracks.title: Five Steps and a Somersault
tracks.story: A critter tries a new way of walking. The fifth step always becomes a tumble.
tracks.personality: A lopsided 3+2 pulse dance with mallet answers and wooden clicks.

tracks.title: Seven Screws for a Tiny Roof
tracks.story: Measure, fit, listen, try again. Something handmade becomes a home.
tracks.personality: A 2+2+3 mallet machine; the melody is built from the work rhythm, then the tools fall quiet.

tracks.title: Try Again, with Both Hands
tracks.story: The first attempt failed. You count in again, a little steadier this time.
tracks.personality: A dry saw riff that sheds notes as it finds confidence; square bass and low toms.

tracks.title: Rain after the Conversation
tracks.story: You replay something you wish you had said differently. Rain gives the thought enough room.
tracks.personality: A slow piano elegy; exposed sixths, delayed resolutions and two genuinely empty bars.

tracks.title: All the Little Lights Are On
tracks.story: You check every habitat. Every little life is safe, and your shoulders finally drop.
tracks.personality: A floating sine melody resolves a suspended harmony; the bell enters only after the worry passes.

tracks.title: Something Heard You Listening
tracks.story: A sound stops when you stop. You wait long enough to hear that it is small, too.
tracks.personality: Low organ pedals and widely spaced glass notes; fear comes from silence and a semitone, never detuning.

tracks.title: Water at the Door
tracks.story: The water is rising. There is still time to move every tank if you keep thinking.
tracks.personality: A 3+2+2 pulse alarm; changing accents, clipped bass and a deliberately interrupted motor.

tracks.title: Courage Is a Small Thing
tracks.story: Your hands shake, but you take your turn. Courage is choosing to protect what is small.
tracks.personality: A saw-and-square battle rondo: a fast hook, a half-time challenge, then a new final answer.

tracks.title: Make Room for Everyone
tracks.story: One more habitat can fit if everyone carries a corner. No one gets left outside.
tracks.personality: An organ passacaglia over a descending four-bar bass; a measured triple-time march.

tracks.title: The Whole Street Cheered
tracks.story: Good news travels from porch to porch until the whole street is celebrating.
tracks.personality: A bright square-wave jig in short, breathy phrases; offbeat nylon chords and a small kit.

tracks.title: Leave a Chair beside You
tracks.story: An apology is awkward. Leaving space for someone can be the first gentle answer.
tracks.personality: Two piano voices start apart, then share a cadence; a soft triangle arrives only near the end.

tracks.title: New Leaves, Uneven Edges
tracks.story: New growth is crooked at first. You notice it anyway.
tracks.personality: A breathy flute over open nylon strings; the Dorian sixth lifts the tune without forcing a happy ending.

tracks.title: A Universe behind the Glass
tracks.story: In the tank, a leaf turns slowly. For a moment it looks like a whole planet.
tracks.personality: An ambient constellation: isolated glass tones orbit three slow, open harmonies. No beat grid is played aloud.

tracks.title: Filter Hum at 1 AM
tracks.story: The house is asleep. The tank filter keeps you company while the last thought drifts away.
tracks.personality: A restrained half-time lo-fi beat, mellow electric-piano ninths, and an unhurried low melody.

tracks.title: One Critter, One Very Big Day
tracks.story: Critter discovers its reflection, a snack, and a hiding place. All three are astonishing.
tracks.personality: Bubbly FM pips in tiny three-eighth-note cells, with a wooden bass and absolutely no pad.

tracks.title: Postcard from Liarsville
tracks.story: A postcard smells faintly of a place you miss. You are glad someone remembered to write.
tracks.personality: A clarinet-like reed waltz that wanders into the relative minor; piano accompaniment follows a descending inner line.

tracks.title: Downhill with Your Arms Out
tracks.story: The road tips downhill and the sky seems to get wider. You remember how light a day can feel.
tracks.personality: A filtered saw lead over offbeat chords, a melodic sine bass, and a breezy straight beat.

tracks.title: The Footprint That Stops
tracks.story: The footprints end beside an ordinary stone. You start looking at ordinary things differently.
tracks.personality: A pizzicato puzzle in 3+2; low flute questions and one high bell that never quite answers.

tracks.title: A Pocket Full of Snow
tracks.story: You bring a melting handful home to show someone. They listen as if it is treasure.
tracks.personality: A music-box lullaby in a low, gentle register; widely spaced felt-piano fifths.

tracks.title: Salt Air, Empty Calendar
tracks.story: There is nowhere you need to be. A slow walk is enough of a plan.
tracks.personality: A nylon-string barcarolle with an organ appearing like distant boats; no bass track or drum kit.

tracks.title: Porch Radio, Last Summer
tracks.story: The song on the porch radio is new, but the afternoon feels remembered.
tracks.personality: A warm electric-piano pocket with straight sixteenths, a triangle countermelody, and dry rim clicks. No artificial tape wobble.

tracks.title: Fireflies Need No Audience
tracks.story: The fireflies keep making their little lights whether anyone is watching or not.
tracks.personality: Only sine and felt piano; a five-note palette, irregular entries, long rests and no harmonic urgency.

tracks.title: Thank You for This Ordinary Day
tracks.story: Nothing spectacular happened. You cared for small lives, came home, and will get another day.
tracks.personality: A through-composed piano-and-flute epilogue; each phrase moves forward and the final harmony stays open.
